*** Add File: /Users/yubo/Documents/Honda/poppy-sandbox/E010/D-v2-plan2-kfree-openai-gpt-6-luna-1119/K1-r2/out/check_data_1.py
+import csv
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+OUTPUT = ROOT / "out" / "check_1.csv"
+
+con = duckdb.connect()
+con.execute("CREATE VIEW crashes AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet(?)", [str(DATA)])
+
+facts = []
+
+def add(fact, value):
+    facts.append((fact, value))
+
+
+scope = "crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01' AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'"
+total = con.execute(f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE {scope}").fetchone()[0]
+add("included crash rows, 2013–2025", total)
+
+year_rows = con.execute(
+    f"""
+    SELECT YEAR(crash_date) AS year, COUNT(*) AS row_count,
+           MIN(crash_date) AS first_crash_date, MAX(crash_date) AS last_crash_date
+    FROM crashes
+    WHERE {scope}
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).fetchall()
+observed = {row[0] for row in year_rows}
+for year in range(2013, 2026):
+    matching = next((row for row in year_rows if row[0] == year), None)
+    if matching:
+        _, count, first_date, last_date = matching
+        add(f"{year} included crash rows", count)
+        add(f"{year} date coverage, first–last", f"{first_date}–{last_date}")
+        expected_start = f"{year}-01-01"
+        expected_end = f"{year}-12-31"
+        partial = str(first_date) != expected_start or str(last_date) != expected_end
+        add(f"{year} year coverage", "partial or no endpoint record" if partial else "both calendar endpoints represented; interior-day completeness not established")
+    else:
+        add(f"{year} included crash rows", 0)
+        add(f"{year} date coverage, first–last", "no included rows")
+        add(f"{year} year coverage", "no included rows")
+
+# Values of crash_date are necessarily non-null and inside the requested years
+# for rows in this population. The typed DATE column cannot contain an invalid
+# calendar date; common placeholder dates outside 2013–2025 are out of scope.
+add("crash_date missing among included rows", 0)
+add("crash_date invalid calendar dates among included rows", 0)
+add("crash_date known placeholder date within included years", "none identified; conventional placeholder dates lie outside the planned years")
+
+missing_ped_killed = con.execute(
+    f"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crashes WHERE {scope} AND number_of_pedestrians_killed IS NULL"
+).fetchone()[0]
+add("number_of_pedestrians_killed missing among included rows", missing_ped_killed)
+
+with OUTPUT.open("w", newline="") as f:
+    writer = csv.writer(f)
+    writer.writerow(["fact", "value"])
+    writer.writerows(facts)
+
+con.close()
*** End Patch

*** Add File: /Users/yubo/Documents/Honda/poppy-sandbox/E010/D-v2-plan2-kfree-openai-gpt-6-luna-1119/K1-r2/out/analyze_1.py
+import csv
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+
+data_path = str(DATA).replace("'", "''")
+con = duckdb.connect()
+rows = con.execute(
+    f"""
+    SELECT YEAR(crash_date) AS year,
+           SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed) AS pedestrians_killed
+    FROM read_parquet('{data_path}')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).fetchall()
+con.close()
+
+expected_years = list(range(2013, 2026))
+values = {int(year): int(count) for year, count in rows}
+if set(values) != set(expected_years):
+    raise ValueError(f"Expected one group for each year 2013–2025; got {sorted(values)}")
+
+values_path = OUT / "values_1.csv"
+with values_path.open("w", newline="") as f:
+    writer = csv.writer(f)
+    writer.writerow(["year", "pedestrians_killed"])
+    writer.writerows((year, values[year]) for year in expected_years)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 6.2))
+bars = ax.bar(expected_years, [values[year] for year in expected_years], color="#276FBF", width=0.72)
+ax.set_title(
+    "Pedestrians killed per year in NYC police-reported motor vehicle crashes\n2013–2025",
+    fontsize=15,
+    pad=20,
+)
+ax.set_xlabel("Crash year")
+ax.set_ylabel("Pedestrian deaths (people)")
+ax.set_xticks(expected_years)
+ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{values[year]:,}" for year in expected_years], padding=3, fontsize=8)
+fig.text(
+    0.5,
+    0.015,
+    "Counts include police-reported crashes; endpoint dates are present for each year, but within-year completeness is unverified.",
+    ha="center",
+    fontsize=9,
+)
+fig.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.055, 1, 1])
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
*** End Patch

+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+
+data_path = str(DATA).replace("'", "''")
+con = duckdb.connect()
+rows = con.execute(
+    f"""
+    SELECT YEAR(crash_date) AS year,
+           SUM(number_of_pedestrians_killed) AS pedestrians_killed
+    FROM read_parquet('{data_path}')
+    WHERE crash_date >= DATE '2013-01-01'
+      AND crash_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """
+).fetchall()
+con.close()
+
+expected_years = list(range(2013, 2026))
+values = {int(year): int(count) for year, count in rows}
+if set(values) != set(expected_years):
+    raise ValueError(f"Expected one group for each year 2013–2025; got {sorted(values)}")
+
+values_path = OUT / "values_1.csv"
+with values_path.open("w", newline="") as f:
+    writer = csv.writer(f)
+    writer.writerow(["year", "pedestrians_killed"])
+    writer.writerows((year, values[year]) for year in expected_years)
+
+fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 6.2))
+bars = ax.bar(expected_years, [values[year] for year in expected_years], color="#276FBF", width=0.72)
+ax.set_title(
+    "Pedestrians killed per year in NYC police-reported motor vehicle crashes\n2013–2025",
+    fontsize=15,
+    pad=20,
+)
+ax.set_xlabel("Crash year")
+ax.set_ylabel("Pedestrian deaths (people)")
+ax.set_xticks(expected_years)
+ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)
+ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.25)
+ax.set_axisbelow(True)
+ax.bar_label(bars, labels=[f"{values[year]:,}" for year in expected_years], padding=3, fontsize=8)
+fig.text(
+    0.5,
+    0.015,
+    "Counts include police-reported crashes; endpoint dates are present for each year, but within-year completeness is unverified.",
+    ha="center",
+    fontsize=9,
+)
+fig.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.055, 1, 1])
+fig.savefig(OUT / "option_1.png", dpi=180, bbox_inches="tight")
+plt.close(fig)
